rule: Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the verse that comes immediately after the current text in the same song, written the way a human songwriter would write it. Do not use any of these words: tapestry, echo, whisper, dance, symphony, silence, shadow, embrace, journey, soul, realm, weave. Do not use the phrase 'not just', and do not write any sentence of the form 'not X but Y'.
text: The tide came in an hour early.
